mapper.sql: S.SCHD_ID, S.SCHD_CLSF_CD, S.SCHD_NM, S.BEGIN_DT, S.END_DT, S.ALL_DAY_YN, S.REPT_YN, S.SCHD_WRTR_ID, S.SCHD_REGST_DT, E.EMP_NM AS WRTR_NM, D.DEPT_NM AS WRTR_DEPT_NM
FROM TB_INTG_SCHD S LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON S.SCHD_WRTR_ID = E.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON E.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD
mapper.select: SELECT SCHD_ID, SCHD_CLSF_CD, SCHD_NM, SCHD_DETAIL_CN, BEGIN_DT, END_DT, SCHD_WRTR_ID, SCHD_REGST_DT, SCHD_CHGR_ID, SCHD_CHG_DT, ALL_DAY_YN, DEL_YN, DEL_DT, REPT_YN, REPT_TYPE_CD, REPT_END_DT FROM TB_INTG_SCHD WHERE SCHD_ID = #{schdId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_SCHD_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_INTG_SCHD ( SCHD_ID, SCHD_CLSF_CD, SCHD_NM, SCHD_DETAIL_CN, BEGIN_DT, END_DT, SCHD_WRTR_ID, SCHD_REGST_DT, ALL_DAY_YN, DEL_YN, REPT_YN, REPT_TYPE_CD, REPT_END_DT ) VALUES ( #{schdId}, #{schdClsfCd}, #{schdNm}, #{schdDetailCn}, #{beginDt}, #{endDt}, #{schdWrtrId}, SYSDATE, #{allDayYn}, 'N', #{reptYn}, #{reptTypeCd}, #{reptEndDt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_INTG_SCHD SET SCHD_CLSF_CD = #{schdClsfCd}, SCHD_NM = #{schdNm}, SCHD_DETAIL_CN = #{schdDetailCn}, BEGIN_DT = #{beginDt}, END_DT = #{endDt}, ALL_DAY_YN = #{allDayYn}, REPT_YN = #{reptYn}, REPT_TYPE_CD = #{reptTypeCd}, REPT_END_DT = #{reptEndDt}, SCHD_CHGR_ID = #{schdChgrId}, SCHD_CHG_DT = SYSDATE WHERE SCHD_ID = #{schdId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE TB_INTG_SCHD SET DEL_YN = 'Y', DEL_DT = SYSDATE, SCHD_CHGR_ID = #{schdId}, SCHD_CHG_DT = SYSDATE WHERE SCHD_ID = #{schdId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
